name: uncounterable_shifting_ceratops_twin
note: Twin of uncounterable_shifting_ceratops: the same window and the same unpayable Convolute, cast at a Centaur Courser, which can be countered. It is, and goes to the graveyard. So the Ceratops pack's green is the 'can't be countered' ability, not the window or the unless cost.
